title: Characterization of bounded numerical degree
statement: Let $n,D\ge 0$, and let $c$ assign a real coefficient to each subset of the $n$-coordinate set. The numerical degree of $c$ is at most $D$ if and only if every subset with nonzero coefficient has cardinality at most $D$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ assigns a real number to each coordinate subset
